query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' WITH DISTINCT r,cr,sp.specNumber AS specNumber UNWIND split(cr.clausesAffected,',') AS raw WITH r,cr,specNumber,trim(raw) AS clause WHERE clause <> '' MATCH (s:Section {sectionNumber:clause})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:specNumber}) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber,specNumber,clause,s.sectionId AS sectionId
